1308-2457-4289-8296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

339-647-677-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1228-5470-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
1228-5470-6495.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat from step 2.
1228-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-6458-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-6458-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6458-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

277-3129-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-3129-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1263-2301-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-527-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3490-4659-4716-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-4716-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4659-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4659-6823.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1558-3557-6741.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five multicolored permanents.
An opponent cannot block Brago.
1558-3557-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Brago triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

38-5220-5332-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2279-3129-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-3129-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2060-4875-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}
Repeat.
2060-4875-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Crystalline Crawler for additional mana.

500-2523-4365-4772.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-2523-4365-4772.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

4091-4613-5251.easyPrerequisites:
Emmara has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord does not have summoning sickness.
4091-4613-5251.description:
Activate Emmara using Aphetto Alchemist's ability by tapping it.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-2523-5561.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Relentless Rohirrim trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2770-5231-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2770-5231-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

511-817-2557-3062-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1429-5256-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5256-5958.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2082-3197-4050.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
2082-3197-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2082-3197-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.

1753-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
1753-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

413-2178-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
413-2178-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature token.
When the Eldrazi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1117-2921-4715-4986.description:
Cast Prized Statue by paying {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Prized Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Prized Statue.
When Prized Statue leaves the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junk Diver.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Prized Statue from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

891-2523-5147-5515.easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2523-5147-5515.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2313-2571-4490-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2313-2571-4490-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
If Devoted Druid has a +1/+1 counter on it, repeat from step 1 until Devoted Druid has no +1/+1 counters.
Activate Devoted Druid's outlast ability by paying {G} and tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

681-1315-1637-4423-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and three additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
681-1315-1637-4423-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and three other lands, causing you to gain ten life.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Each land enters the battlefield, triggering Aesi that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.

742-2173-4996.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 6 or higher.
742-2173-4996.description:
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming a card not in your library and exiling your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 3.

186-800-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Knacksaw Clique.
Knacksaw Clique does not have summoning sickness.
186-800-4474.description:
Activate Knacksaw Clique by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Knacksaw Clique by paying {U} and untap it, exiling the top card of target opponent's library.
Repeat.

661-777-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2}.
Sculpting Steel enters the battlefield as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
Sculpting Steel enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel triggers, returning to your hand.
Repeat.

804-2533-3175-5256.notablePrerequisites: It is your first main phase.
804-2533-3175-5256.description:
Cast Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield you may, return Loyal Retainers to the battlefield.
Activate Loyal Retainers, targeting Sakashima the Impostor.
Have Sakashima the Impostor enter as a copy of Sun Titan.
With Sakashima's enter the battlefield ability, return Loyal Retainers to the battlefield.
Sacrifice Sakashima to Altar of Dementia.
Activate Loyal Retainers, targeting Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.
